headline: The Jeep Recon is already being produced in Mexico for our market, days before its presentation
summary: The first Jeep Recon, an electric Jeep with Trail Rated certification, has been built in Mexico for the local market. The first unit for Mexico has left the production line in Toluca.
why: Stellantis is a global automaker, and local production of new models in Mexico reflects its manufacturing footprint and supply chain in the country.
original_headline: El Jeep Recon ya se produce en México para nuestro mercado, a días de su presentación
